card.name: Start of interferon drug names
card.fires_on: The piece "inter" (or " interfer") that begins the word interferon, usually after peg, beta, or alpha in antiviral and MS drug labels. It also fires weakly on "Inter" in "Interference".

modes.label: Interferon names
modes.description: The opening piece of interferon, mostly after peg or a hyphen, just before "feron".
modes.example: When SOVALDI is used in combination with ribavirin or peg<<inter>>feron alfa/ribavir

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the "inter" start of interferon, as in peginterferon, when the word is split into parts.
